status: reviewed: blind slant review (R1, R2), meaning checks (M3, M4; M5, M6). Adopted 2026-11-03.
rule: display text may differ from the proposition only when two blind reviewers judge them equivalent

statements.proposition: AI is best understood as a new kind of mind, more than a tool or artifact.
statements.display: AI is better understood as a new kind of mind than as a tool or artifact.

statements.proposition: Advanced AI poses a real risk of human extinction.
How technology reshapes work and society is decided by collective choice rather than an inevitable process.
statements.display: How technology reshapes work and society is set by collective choices rather than by a fixed course of development.

statements.proposition: Technology-driven productivity growth leaves most workers better off without any change in public policy.
statements.display: Technology-driven productivity growth leaves most workers better off even if public policy stays as it is.

statements.proposition: Individual freedom and democracy are compatible.
Public promises about advanced AI are mostly inflated hype.
Liberal and humane ideals have enough inherent force to prevail in long contests between societies.
statements.display: Liberal and humane ideals are strong enough in themselves to win out in long contests between societies.

statements.proposition: Market competition limits the harm that economic actors can do.
Human beings should remain the end that AI serves, and should not be treated as a stage to surpass.
statements.display: AI should serve human beings as its end, and humanity should not be treated as a stage to be surpassed.

statements.proposition: Public fear of AI exceeds what the evidence supports.
The AI dangers most worth attention come from present human deployment of AI, not from autonomous superintelligent agents.
statements.display: The AI dangers that most deserve attention come from how people deploy AI now, not from autonomous superintelligent agents.

statements.proposition: AI systems may come to merit rights or moral consideration.
The history of earlier general-purpose technologies is a valid guide to how AI will behave and be received.
statements.display: The history of earlier general-purpose technologies is a valid guide to how AI will behave and how people will receive it.

statements.proposition: On hard questions, deferring to base rates or the average of informed opinion is a sound default over one's own reasoning.
statements.display: On hard questions, base rates or the average of informed opinion should by default outweigh one's own reasoning.

statements.proposition: Popular self-government should remain the basis of political authority, rather than rule by experts, executives or other unelected powers.
statements.display: Political authority should rest on popular self-government rather than on experts, executives or other unelected powers.

statements.proposition: Market-driven technological development serves human beings on balance.
statements.display: On balance, market-driven technological development is good for people.

statements.proposition: Governments should impose binding rules on frontier AI developers.
Stringent AI regulation now would do more harm than good by deterring innovation.
statements.display: Strict AI regulation now would do more harm than good, because it would deter innovation.

statements.proposition: AI development should remain separate from state direction and control.
statements.display: AI development should not be directed or controlled by the state.

statements.proposition: Technology should aim at cooperation across diverse groups rather than convergence on a singularity.
statements.display: Technology should aim to help diverse groups cooperate rather than to reach a technological singularity.

statements.proposition: Rivalry with China is a sound reason for the United States to press ahead in advanced technology and protect its lead.
statements.display: Rivalry with China is a good reason for the United States to push ahead in advanced technology and keep its lead.

statements.proposition: Distributing wealth or ownership directly to citizens is a sound way to share technology's gains.
Development of the most powerful general AI systems should be deliberately slowed or stopped.
Serious work on controlling advanced AI should happen well before such systems exist.

notes: ai-promises-inflated keeps its original wording: no rewrite passed both meaning checks. It is deliberately mirrored by ai-fear-exceeds-evidence, which leans the other way.
ai-fear-exceeds-evidence and plan-control-early were rated slightly slanted in opposite directions; rewrites that fixed this changed their meaning, so both keep their wording.
Replaced before launch: ai-discourse-is-saturated-with-hype (a near-duplicate of ai-promises-inflated) and ai-can-be-given-good-values (asked two questions at once: can and should).
